description: /new with a prompt uses the main repository. {{REPO}} is a git repository with a worktree {{WORKTREE}}; conversation {{ID}} runs in the worktree. Call "saved" reports the first message the page sends: "none" before it, then "ok cwd=<the conversation's saved working directory> draft=<whether it is still a draft>". To "send P and expect cwd C": fill [data-testid="message-input"] with P; call "saved", which must return exactly "none"; click [data-testid="send-button"]; then call "saved" until it returns exactly "ok cwd=C draft=false". To "check and send in C": the directory control's text should contain C; press Escape; then send "echo: new conversation directory" and expect cwd C. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}}. 2. Send "/new echo: new conversation directory" and expect cwd {{REPO}}.
